newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya Airways 96/97 profit down 39.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kenya Airways 96/97 profit down 39.5 pct.

text.p: National carrier Kenya Airways profits for the year ended March 31 dropped 39.5 percent despite a marginal rise in turnover, airline officials said on Thursday.
A statement issued by the airline said the decline was expected following an increase in fuel and labour costs but was aggravated by a strong shilling in the period.

"The continuing strength of the Kenyan shilling generated translation losses of 322 million shillings, a reverse of the previous year when a weakening local currency provided significant foreign exchange gains," the statement said.
It said net profit after tax for the year ended 31 March 1997 was 851.6 million shillings ($14.4 million) compared to 1.419 billion shillings for the previous year.
